mapper.update: INSERT INTO women_activity_info (merge_key, female_workers_proportion_type, female_workers_proportion, female_share_of_manager, gender_total_of_manager, female_share_of_officers, gender_total_of_officers) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{femaleWorkersProportionType}, #{femaleWorkersProportion}, #{femaleShareOfManager}, #{genderTotalOfManager}, #{femaleShareOfOfficers}, #{genderTotalOfOfficers}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO UPDATE SET female_workers_proportion_type = EXCLUDED.female_workers_proportion_type, female_workers_proportion = EXCLUDED.female_workers_proportion, female_share_of_manager = EXCLUDED.female_share_of_manager, gender_total_of_manager = EXCLUDED.gender_total_of_manager, female_share_of_officers = EXCLUDED.female_share_of_officers, gender_total_of_officers = EXCLUDED.gender_total_of_officers WHERE ( women_activity_info.female_workers_proportion_type, women_activity_info.female_workers_proportion, women_activity_info.female_share_of_manager, women_activity_info.gender_total_of_manager, women_activity_info.female_share_of_officers, women_activity_info.gender_total_of_officers ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.female_workers_proportion_type, EXCLUDED.female_workers_proportion, EXCLUDED.female_share_of_manager, EXCLUDED.gender_total_of_manager, EXCLUDED.female_share_of_officers, EXCLUDED.gender_total_of_officers )
